name: agentflow
description: Run host-native multi-agent development and governed evidence-driven improvement workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate multi-agent coding with review and traceability.
interface.longDescription: Use the coding host's native agents as a bounded engineering team with frontend, backend, technical director, supervisor, and reviewer roles. Agentflow defines the workflow and contracts without invoking a separate orchestration CLI or requiring another provider credential.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $agentflow to coordinate this coding task with bounded delegation, independent review, and a concise decision record.
